course.title: Start Here
course.description_md:
**This Start Here course does two things:** it shows you everything you have access to and how we operate day-to-day, and it starts you on a four-week journey to build the foundational habits of a 0DTE trader.

By the end, you’ll understand the basics of 0DTE strategy and the core FatTail concepts, and you’ll have run a weekly pro-level trading routine for yourself — at least three full Retrospective cycles, ready to send to Coach Ernie for review.

**Here’s the part that matters**: even if you stop after four weeks, you keep it all. The strategy basics, the FatTail concepts, and a weekly routine that will serve you for the rest of your trading life. That’s yours regardless of what you decide next.

*Already past your first four weeks, or here another way? Same routine — your own timeline.*

content_blocks.body_md:
Welcome to FatTail AI

**Watch This Video** to understand what’s in store.

We’re thrilled to have you on board—let’s get serious!

Before you dive in, here’s the shape of the next four weeks — and of life in the service generally.

### You’ve got more than a course

The moment you’re in, you have access to a deep library: years of archived content, recordings, and material from the community, plus the other FatTail courses — all reachable from your **My Account Dashboard**. You’re not starting from zero. You’re stepping into something with a long history behind it.

### We operate on a rhythm

Trading here isn’t a string of one-off events — it’s a routine. There’s a **daily** beat, where we show up, review real trades, and run the loop. And there’s a **weekly** beat, anchored by our **Sunday meeting**, where we step back and look at the bigger picture before the week begins.

The daily work builds the reps. The weekly work turns reps into judgment. You’ll feel the difference fast.

### This is expectation-driven

Read that as the deal, both ways. We’ll be clear about what to do and when — but nobody trades the routine for you. What you get out of these four weeks is a direct function of what you put in.

Show up to the meetings, run the daily loop, and do the weekly Retrospective honestly, and the habits form. Skip them, and they won’t. The structure is here; the doing is yours. That’s not a limitation — it’s the whole point. We’re building *your* judgment, not a dependency.

### Where you land at the end of four weeks

By the end, you’ll have:

- A high-level grasp of the **0DTE strategy** and the core **FatTail concepts**.
- Run the daily routine for real and completed **at least three weekly Retrospectives**.
- Sent those retros to **Coach Ernie** for a personal review of your thinking.

Whatever you decide after that, you’ll own a weekly trading routine that serves you for the rest of your trading life.

---

*That’s what’s ahead. The next lessons get you set up and started. Let’s go.*

🛑 **Read this one before you go anywhere else.** Five minutes here and you’re fully wired into everything — the community, the live meetings, and the app. Don’t skip it and try to figure it out later; do it now, and the rest of the course makes sense. 👇

👋 **You’ve got a live onboarding call coming up.** One of the first steps in your Observer journey is a personal onboarding call with **Lakesia**, who’ll walk you through everything and answer your questions face-to-face. But that call is scheduled — and you’re here now. So this lesson is your **quick start**: just enough to get connected and moving today. Don’t worry about mastering it all; Lakesia’s got you for the deep dive. ✅

### 1️⃣ Get into Discord 💬

Discord is home base — it’s where the community lives, where the meetings happen, and where members post their trades every day. Getting connected takes one click:

1. Go to **My Account → Dashboard** on the website.
2. Under **Discord connection**, click the green **Connect to Discord** button.
3. That links your FatTail membership to Discord and automatically assigns your member role. Done.

![](https://fattail.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Screen-Shot-2026-06-27-at-9.45.19-AM-300x223.png)

🆕 **Don’t have a Discord account yet?** No problem. Discord is a free service in its own right, *separate* from your FatTail website login. After you click **Connect to Discord**, you’ll be prompted to register a Discord account first — once that’s set up, the connection completes automatically. (Your FatTail website email and password and your Discord login are two different things.)

💡 **Already in the server from before?** Click **Connect to Discord** again anyway — that’s what refreshes your role to match your current membership. Don’t skip it.

Once you’re in, **start in the `start-here` channel** 📍, then get familiar with the channels that matter most:

- 📈 **`fattail-talk`** — everything about the strategy, the process, the methods. And *nothing else.*
- 🛋️ **`fattail-lounge`** — everything that *isn’t* strategy, process, or methods. Off-topic, casual, anything goes.
- 📝 **`fattail-trade`** — where members record their daily trades. Read it for real trades in real time; post yours once you’re running the loop.

⚠️ **Important — watch for scammers.** Trading communities attract impersonators. 🚫 Coach Ernie and the admins will **never DM you first**, never ask for money, never ask to manage your funds, and never ask for your password or login. If someone messages you claiming to be Ernie or an admin offering signals, returns, or “help” with your account — **it’s a scam.** Don’t reply, don’t click links, and report it. When in doubt, ask out loud in a public channel. 🙋

### 2️⃣ Join the daily and weekly meetings 📅

We meet live, daily, and weekly. The **Zoom link is posted in the `daily-live-meetings` channel.** 🔗 That’s your one place to look; check there for the link and the schedule, and show up. The meetings are the heartbeat of the service. ❤️

### 3️⃣ Catch up on anything you missed 🎥

Can’t make a session live? Every meeting is recorded. Head to the **`daily-video-archive`** channel for past meetings so you never fall behind. ⏪

### 4️⃣ Log into the app 💻

The FatTail app is where your trading tools live. To get in, go to **[flyonthewall.io](https://flyonthewall.io)** 🔐 and log in with the **same credentials you use for the FatTail website.** (Yes — the app’s address still carries the old name. Same company, same account, fully legit. ✅ Use your website email and password.)

---

🎉 **That’s it — you’re connected.** Discord’s open, you know where the meetings are, and you’re into the app. Now keep going: the next lessons show you how we actually trade and the daily routine you’ll build over the next four weeks. 🚀

🗺️ Here’s your plan for the next four weeks. It’s a rhythm, not a rulebook — adjust it to your schedule, but follow the arc. By the end you’ll have built a real trading routine and run it for yourself.

![](https://fattail.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/4week-roadmap.jpg)

### ⚙️ The engine: your daily & weekly loop

Before the weeks, understand the rhythm that runs *through* all of them. Everything in FatTail comes back to one simple loop:

![](https://fattail.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/weekly-daily.jpg)

**Every trading day** 📆

- 🔍 **Analyze** — each morning, **follow Coach Ernie’s lead.** Watch the premarket analysis live and learn how the day’s read comes together — the volatility regime, the trend, the levels that matter. You’re not doing this solo yet; you’re learning the routine by watching it done.
- 🎯 **Execute** — when a setup appears, **watch how Coach and other members select and place trades** — trading with the trend, and managing the position for profit as it develops. Follow along and see the decisions in real time.
- 📝 **Reflect** — after the close, **log your trade** and capture what you saw and decided. Keep your own running journal as you go — more on how below.

**Every week** 🔄

- 🪞 **Retrospective** — a Retrospective is just another journal entry, written more analytically. Same system you’re already using — you’re just stepping back and looking across the week instead of the day. Focus on two things: your **discretionary choices** (where did you use judgment, and how did it play out?) and your **evolving stats** (what are the numbers starting to tell you?). Not sure what to look for? **Ask Coach** — that’s what he’s here for, and the things worth examining will grow as you do.

📈 **Your retros evolve week to week.** Week 1 is your **anchor** — a baseline, not a masterpiece. Don’t worry if it feels thin; you’re establishing the starting point you’ll measure everything against. By weeks 3 and 4, you’ll have real history to analyze, and the retros get sharper on their own.

That’s the whole machine. The four weeks just turn the crank. 🛠️

---

### 1️⃣ Week 1 — Observe & Orient 👀

Get settled in. Watch the daily meetings, read the channels, and start absorbing how we trade. Begin running the loop in **observe mode** — analyze and reflect on the day even if you’re not placing trades yet.

✅ **End of week: your first Retrospective.**

### 2️⃣ Week 2 — Run the Loop 🔁

Now you’re doing it for real. Analyze → execute → reflect, every day. Bring your questions to the community and the Sunday meeting — this is when things start to click.

✅ **End of week: your second Retrospective.**

### 3️⃣ Week 3 — Sharpen 🔪

The reps are adding up. Read setups faster, manage intraday instead of holding and hoping, and tighten your process. You’ll feel yourself getting smoother.

✅ **End of week: your third Retrospective.**

### 4️⃣ Week 4 — Consolidate & Send 📤

Keep running the loop, then bring it all together. Package your Retrospectives — your logs, notes, and journals — and **[send them to Coach Ernie](https://fattail.ai/feedback/send-to-coach/) for a personal review.** No formal template; files or a zip is fine.

✅ **End of week: retros sent, routine built.**

🏆 **Here’s what you walk away with.** Four weeks in, you’ll understand the basics of 0DTE strategy and the core FatTail concepts — and you’ll have run a weekly pro-level routine that serves you for the rest of your trading life. That’s yours to keep, whatever you decide next.

---

➡️ **Next up:** the courses that take you deeper. But don’t wait to start — your Week 1 begins now. Get into the daily meetings and run your first loop today. 🚀

📚 You’ve got the routine. These four courses give you the depth behind it. You don’t need to take them all at once — here’s what each one is for and when to dig in.

🧭 **Not sure where to start? Start with 0DTE Foundations.** It directly supports the trade you’re learning to run during your four weeks. Take it first, and let the others follow.

---

### 🎯 0DTE Foundations — start here first

The core mechanics of the 0DTE trade: strike placement, the zones, entry events — the technical how-to behind the daily loop you’re building. This is the one that turns “I get the idea” into “I know exactly what I’m doing.”

👉 **When:** during your four weeks, alongside the daily routine.

🔗 [Open 0DTE Foundations](#)

---

### 🧠 FatTail Foundations — the why behind the what

The philosophy and core concepts: convexity, positioning instead of predicting, and the FatTail worldview that runs underneath *every* strategy here — not just 0DTE. This is what makes the mechanics make sense, and what keeps you out of the common traps.

👉 **When:** alongside or right after 0DTE Foundations.

🔗 [Open FatTail Foundations](#)

---

### 🚀 FatTail Campaigns — the full strategy family

FatTail is built to grow past the primary 0DTE trade — and Campaigns is where the whole family lives, organized by **days to expiration (DTE)**. The further out you go, the less hands-on it gets, so there’s a campaign to fit almost any trading lifestyle:

- ⚡ **0DTE** — the primary strategy. Extreme asymmetry: small risk, large potential reward.
- 🦇 **Batman** — a 0DTE edge case for **high VIX**, extending to 1–2 DTE.
- 🌀 **Time Warp** — a 0DTE edge case for **low VIX**, also stretching to 1–2 DTE.
- 📚 **Convex Stack** — the 3–5 DTE strategy.
- 🌊 **Sigma Drift** — the 6–10 DTE strategy.

The Campaigns course details all of them — when each one fits, how the regime (VIX) points you to the right play, and how to match a campaign to the time you actually have.

👉 **When:** once your 0DTE routine feels solid and you’re ready to expand your range.

🔗 [Open FatTail Campaigns](#)

---

### 🛠️ FatTail App — your tools, in perpetual beta

The app is where your trading tools live — and it’s in **perpetual beta**, always being built and refined. Here’s the honest state of it so you know what to expect.

**✅ Live and ready now:**

- 🔥 **Convexity Heatmap** — fully functional. View and test strategies at a glance.
- 📊 **Risk Graph** — ~90% there and already very useful. See a position’s payoff and asymmetry before you commit.
- 🧩 **Widgets** — plus copy-and-paste straight to **ThinkorSwim**.

**🚧 In development (not yet live):**

- 🎮 A full-fledged **trade simulator**
- 🔗 **External broker integration**
- 📓 **Trade Log, Journal, Retrospective & Playbook**

These are coming, but they’re not in play yet — so don’t go looking for them. We’d rather ship the right tool than a half-finished one. The app gains capabilities over time; expect it to keep growing.

👉 **When:** open it anytime to use the Heatmap and Risk Graph. Bookmark it.

🔗 [Open the FatTail App](#)

---

🔁 **One thing:** don’t disappear into the courses and stop trading. The fastest learners do both at once — keep running your daily loop and your weekly Retrospective *while* you study. The reps and the theory reinforce each other.

🎉 **That’s Start Here, done.** You’re connected, you know the routine, you’ve got your four-week plan, and you know where to go deeper. Now go run Week 1. We’ll see you in the meetings. 👋

📒 Start logging your trades from day one. You don’t need anything fancy — just a simple, consistent record of what you traded and what you were thinking. We’ve built a **trade log template** that captures exactly the information that matters for FatTail trading, so you can build the right habit from the start.

### See one in action first

Here’s Coach Ernie’s own trade log, filled in — so you can see what a real, working log looks like before you start your own. Notice the rhythm: the setup, the numbers, and especially the **notes** — what he saw, what he decided, what he’d do differently.

🔗 **[View Coach’s trade log (example)](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1lD3asTp499Eb4ql2DCi-kD0qfU8t63FWChhnLe5eYY0/edit?usp=sharing)**

### Make your own copy

Now grab your own blank copy. Click the link below — it’ll prompt you to **make a copy** into your own Google Drive. That copy is yours, private, and ready to use.

🔗 **[Get your trade log template →](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1LYKfoTEGSUqfqLJYT-eTK2DBUrLliVVuYvKNsNNhAh4/edit?usp=sharing)**

💡 The link opens a **“Make a copy”** prompt. Click it, and the log saves to *your* Drive — you’re not editing the master, just working in your own private version.

### What to capture

Each row is one trade. Fill in what you can — it gets faster every day:

- 📅 **The setup** — date, VIX regime, trade type, directional bias, width, strikes.
- 💵 **The numbers** — debit paid, contracts, max risk, R2R, entry and exit, P&L.
- 📝 **The notes** — what you saw, what you decided, what you’d change. *This is the most important column.* It’s where the trade becomes a lesson — and it’s what your weekly Retrospective is built from.

📤 **This feeds your retro.** When it’s time to send your Retrospectives to Coach, your trade log goes right along with them — export it or share the link through **Send to Coach**. The notes column *is* your reflection, already done.

➡️ Don’t wait — make your copy now and log your very first observation, even before you place a trade.
